nom: Avène Hydrance Boost Concentrated Hydrating Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin frequently report noticeable hydration and softness, though one says the formula did not provide enough for dehydrated skin in a dry climate.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin are split: several say the serum is gentle, non-irritating and even soothing, while others report agitation, breakouts, redness, or warn that sensitive/dry skin should avoid it.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as older or aging report the serum gives skin a needed hydration boost and helps with fine lines, layering well with other anti-aging products.
segments.combination: One reviewer notes the serum keeps skin hydrated without making it oily, suiting a combination profile.

concerns.aging: Reviewers dealing with aging skin report the serum gives a hydration boost that pairs well with other mature-skin products and helps fine lines feel less noticeable.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report a genuine boost in hydration, softness and glow, sometimes described as skin 'drinking it in'; a minority say it did not moisturize enough or made no noticeable difference.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report the serum caused a few red spots, one attributing it to hyaluronic acid combined with a sunscreen also containing it; others with redness concerns report no irritation and calming effects.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer bought it specifically to support their skin barrier but rejected it on discovering added fragrance, feeling it conflicted with that goal.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the serum helped dry spots without adding oiliness; no other spot-specific complaints are mentioned.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone skin reports breaking out and skin agitation after use, while another with acne-prone, sensitive skin reports the serum was highly effective with no issues.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers largely report the serum is non-greasy and does not add oiliness, but a few describe a sticky, shiny, or greasy residue, especially under makeup.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup and moisturizer
Good value for an HA serum

extraits.texte: Avene' is a staple in my skin care routine. I have very sensitive skin. It's dry and reactive. I have been using this product since it came out, it is a game changer! My skin feels so fresh! And most importantly HYDRATED!! I get the most compliments on my skin. I am a esthetician and i recommend this to all of my clients from acneic to mature skin. Try it you will not be disappointed. Use under moisturizer. 💕💕💕

This Hydrating Concentrated Serum is well named: VERY hydrating (even on dry patches) and VERY concentrated (2 or 3 drops per use). I use this serum morning and night before a moisturizer - I actually notice a huge difference when I use this serum vs. when I skip it. For reference, I have dry, acne-prone, incredibly sensitive skin. Highly recommend this product.

The Hydrance Boost Concentrated Hydrating Serum was disappointing. For a product that claims to provide deep hydration, it fell short. After using it for several weeks, I didn't notice any significant improvement in my skin's moisture levels. In fact, it left my skin feeling sticky and slightly greasy, especially under makeup. The texture is runny and doesn't absorb as well as I expected. Also, the scent is quite strong and not pleasant for something meant for sensitive skin. For the price point, I was expecting much better results. There are definitely more effective hydrating serums on the market that provide better results without the greasy finish or overpowering scent. Wouldn't recommend this product.
It seems to improve my skin hydration; the hyaleronic acid, in addition to hyaleronic acid in my facial sun block is causing a few red spots...

extraits.titre: Perfect for hydrating dry, sensitive skin
extraits.texte: This product is amazing! Instant hydration and recovery for my dry, flaky skin and sensitive skin. It gave me immediate relief (even better with a night cream over it) and my friends even noticed the change. They said my skin looked glowy
I typically love avene so was excited to try this for added moisture and support my skin barrier but it has fragrance! This is a terrible product.
If you need a little boost for aging skin this is a wonderful product! Hydrance Boost Concentrated Hydrating Serum also works in tandem with my other products for older skin.
